was.note: Decided in-session 2026-08-20: decline as already supported. spconv-triton (Apache-2.0, PyPI, MI300X-verified) is a drop-in replacement for spconv 2.x on ROCm, and upstream is not a viable PR destination (no merged PR since 2022-12-27; the one AMD request, #780, was answered by pointing at spconv-triton). A port would mean an unbounded AMD backend for the cumm codegen rather than work on spconv itself. Screened seven times on four platforms, all agreeing. Analysis retained in history: `git show 2cc3927f97db:projects/spconv/notes.md` (notes.md).
